mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the probability of central bank rate cuts, boosting equity valuations via lower discount rates and positive forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative or not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 8.0% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which triggers a policy response from the Fed, leading to lower long-term yields and positive forward S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the likelihood of monetary stimulus and reduces inflation expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative or not significantly positive when INDPRO < 95.0 for 2 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and CPIAUCSL is above 225.0, it indicates a high-inflation, tight-policy regime where equity valuations are suppressed; however, if CPIAUCSL begins to decline while FEDFUNDS remains elevated, it signals disinflation, prompting market anticipation of rate cuts and positive forward SPX returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 225.0 and CPIAUCSL declines in 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, CPIAUCSL > 225.0, and CPIAUCSL declines (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k in a single month, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates labor market overheating and potential wage pressures, which increases the likelihood of aggressive Fed tightening, leading to negative forward S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE increases > 0.2pp in one month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 400,000 million dollars, combined with a drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 680k units, signals a weakening consumer-driven economy, which increases the probability of fiscal or monetary stimulus, leading to positive forward S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS < 400614.0 and HOUST < 685.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 94.0 for two consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates a supply-side shock with labor market deterioration, which increases the likelihood of Fed intervention, leading to positive forward S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO < 94.0 for 2 months (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
